steps:
Open the product page “Khalas dates 1 kg”
Click “أضف إلى السلة” (Add to cart)
Click “إتمام الشراء” (Checkout) and choose to continue without an account
Fill in the shipping address and mobile number
Choose a payment method and click “تأكيد الطلب” (Confirm order)
The order confirmation page shows the order number
success_condition: A confirmation page with the order number appears after clicking “تأكيد الطلب”.
expected_features:
Guest checkout without creating an account
Discount code field on the checkout page
Shipping cost shown before payment
Address data kept when an error occurs
expected_events:
view_item — when the product page opens
add_to_cart — when Add to cart is clicked
begin_checkout — when Checkout is clicked
add_shipping_info — when the shipping address is saved
add_payment_info — when a payment method is chosen
purchase — when the order confirmation page appears
